posts.text: ADHD energy is starting something at 1AM because you finally feel alive.
My ADHD brain doesn’t need more motivation. It needs fewer steps.
ADHD workouts: 3 weeks of consistency, 2 months of recovery.
My ADHD brain is chaotic, but it’s also brilliant at seeing patterns others miss. Can you relate?
If you have ADHD turns procrastination into performance art yet here I am, still thriving.
I didn’t get worse—I finally stopped masking how hard it really was.
